values.en: Write a constructor type as Π Δ, I p̄ t̄. The outer telescope Δ introduces constructor arguments and does not itself negate their types. Within each constructor-argument type, I is forbidden in the domain of any nested Π or arrow; checking continues through codomains and through arguments of type formers explicitly accepted as strictly positive by the positivity policy. Ordinary covariance/contravariance parity is only an intuition, not a complete strict-positivity test: ((I → A) → A) is rejected despite two variance reversals.
values.zh-CN: 把构造子类型写成 Π Δ, I p̄ t̄。外层望远镜 Δ 用来引入构造参数，本身不会把这些参数类型变成负位置。在每个构造参数类型内部，I 不得出现在任何嵌套 Π 或箭头的定义域中；检查沿值域继续，并可穿过正性策略明确认可为严格正的类型构造器参数。普通协变/反变的符号奇偶只提供直觉，并不能完整刻画严格正性：即使经历两次变性翻转，((I → A) → A) 仍会被拒绝。
